rules: Nothing shady: official APIs only, no scraping against terms, no cloaking, no fake reviews or links — CRTLAB must never be flagged
No backend strain: machines read files and caches, never hammer the database or the site
Every change is measured; losers are dropped and remembered
Bounded: every learned setting has a floor and a ceiling; a bad week rolls it back
Free every day stays; no feature gates
Site pushes only on Kai's word
